name: Vivia Twilight
original_name: ヴィヴィア＝トワイライト
source:
One of the Master Detectives dispatched to Kanai Ward. His Forte is Spectral Projection.
He has a decadent and aesthetic atmosphere about him. Often lying down in various places, such as the fireplace at the agency or under the hotel's grand piano, his personality can be described as self-indulgent.
[From [url=https://www.spike-chunsoft.co.jp/raincode/en/character/]official website[/url]
